title: Decide and preserve expired handoff audit semantics on completion recovery
outcome: Typed completion recovery has an explicit, tested contract for expired handoff projection and audit events.
acceptance: A completion recovery combined with an expired handoff either durably records expiry or explicitly documents and tests side-effect-free rollback

completion.summary: Proved expired handoff sweep changes roll back on completion refusal, then audit exactly once on the next successful mutation; documented the transactional consequence.
